T4.9.message: a3 says the hymn earlier 'showed Him wrapped in an elephant's hide'. Nothing backs this. a3 cites only mw-girisha, mw-desha and mw-vesha, and none of them mentions a hide. The only cross-verse link nearby is [vibhūti](#v2-a2), which covers the ash and not the hide. The hide image comes from verse 1 (gajendrasya kṛttiṃ vasānaṃ), but the card gives no link to verse 1 and no citation. mw-krtti.md and mw-gajendra.md are in the evidence folder but a3 does not cite them, and they only define the words, not what the hymn says. The same body also says 'and smeared with ash' and links that to v2-a2, so the two images look like they share one source when they don't.
T4.9.suggested_fix: Link the hide claim to verse 1's annotation that covers it, e.g. 'wrapped in an elephant's hide ([verse 1](#v1-aN))', and keep the ash on its own link: 'and smeared with ash ([vibhūti](#v2-a2))'. If no verse-1 annotation covers the hide, cite the stotram text for verse 1 with a locator, or drop the hide detail.
